description: claude-code-tether/hooks/run-prepare.js emits tether-setup: and tether-onboard: progress markers (and a stamped version) to stderr; evals/margin/scripts/verify-smoke.py matches those exact strings/regexes and cross-checks the version against tether-build.json. The marker text in the hook and the matchers in the verifier must stay in sync (per evals/margin/CLAUDE.md): changing a marker without updating the verifier silently lets a failed install/onboard pass verification or drops onboard telemetry.
